Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes

05/21/2025
A low-speed collision in a parking lot was reported, and the claimant, who is not represented, reports a shoulder
injury. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type.
05/23/2025
Took the claimant's account of the collision. The driver is named on the policy, and coverage was in force at the time
of the loss.
05/26/2025
The police report and witness statements confirm the collision happened as described, and the other driver's account
matches. Police and witnesses also confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
06/01/2025
Scene photos were reviewed and show the vehicles in the positions described by the parties. Witnesses and photos
are consistent with the reported sequence of events.
07/01/2025
Vehicle history and prior claim records show no known earlier damage. Nothing suggests the damage predates the
start of coverage.
07/05/2025
The damage phtoos show dents on a different side of the vehicle and at a different height than the impact the
claimant described. The damage pattern does not match the account given.
08/01/2025
Medical records show the claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that earlier
condition adds to the current complaints.
08/10/2025
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. The claimant gave the same account in
every conversation so far. Referred the damage-pattern question to a supervisor for review.
08/16/2025
Holding the file open pending a repair estimate review and a supervisor decision on the damage-pattern question
before any settlement evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
